controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-17T07:45:35.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T07:45:35.000Z"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.15"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS total = COUNT(*)
| LIMIT 1
